messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Subject: MAP kickoff: HelionHealth - draft & timeline options

Hi Lena / Chris —

Great to meet you both earlier. Thanks for the productive discovery call — super helpful to understand HelionHealth's core latency and compliance needs for the clinic-assistant pilot. As promised, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that outlines milestones, owners, timeline options, and dependencies. High-level summary below and a couple of asks to move to kickoff: 

Quick summary (see attached MAP v1):
- Pilot goal: integrate Redwood Inference hosted API for clinic assistant (secure PHI handling via Private deployment if needed).
- Key milestones: technical kickoff, sandbox trial (2 weeks), production pilot (4 weeks), final handoff/scale decision.
- Proposed target close for pilot go-live: Jan 28, 2027 (option to accelerate to Jan 14).
- Primary dependencies: data access (anonymized sample), SOC2 evidence, API credentials, endpoint/network allowlist.

Draft owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Marissa (project mgmt / commercial), Aditya (solutions / infra), Eng onboarding support
- HelionHealth: Lena (product lead), Chris (platform/security), Procurement (contracts)

Ask / next steps:
1) Please confirm the stakeholders above (Lena / Chris + anyone else we should loop into the MAP).
2) Which timeline option do you prefer? (A — Standard: Jan 28 go-live / B — Accelerated: Jan 14 go-live).
3) Any immediate blockers (procurement windows or security review dates) we should account for?

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP v1), redwood_pricing_summary.xlsx (est. pricing + reserved capacity options).

If it helps, we can run a 30-min kickoff next week to walk the MAP with all stakeholders — I propose Wed 12/2 or Thu 12/3 (PST).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks all — quick technical notes ahead of the kickoff on 12/3: 

1) Data access: For the sandbox trial, we'll need an anonymized sample payload (no PHI) and a short schema doc. If HelionHealth prefers Private deployment, we should list the network allowlist / VPC peering windows in the MAP dependencies.
2) SOC2 + evidence: I'll attach our SOC2 summary and a short data flow diagram to the shared Drive link before the kickoff. Lena — we'll aim to have the SOC2 artifact ready by Dec 6 to give your team time before the Dec 13 review window.
3) Technical kickoff agenda suggestion (15 min): architecture overview, integration steps, test data/credentials, success metrics and monitoring hooks. Remaining 15 min: Q&A and action items.

Marissa — can you update the MAP to add Javier Morales as HelionHealth CTO and lock in Option A (Jan 28)? I'll prep the SOC2 artifact and the data flow diagram.
